question: The average bankruptcy rate and M&A deals by year
query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, AVG(bankruptcy_rate) AS avg_bankruptcy_rate, AVG(mergers_acquisitions_deals) AS avg_mergers FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) LIMIT 50;
